objective: Freeze AR-0 Research Governance for the Alpha Research Fast Track as a versioned, machine-readable, point-in-time-safe and auditable protocol without changing canonical roadmap gates or creating trading authority.
scope: Define and freeze the generic Alpha Research Fast Track research protocol
Define point-in-time safety and fail-closed requirements
Define exploratory and protected confirmatory dataset access boundaries
Define exploratory/confirmatory separation and contamination rules
Define governed metric families without unsupported numeric cutoffs
Define a machine-readable AR-FT evidence envelope JSON Schema
Define a Confirmatory Hypothesis Contract JSON Schema for later AR-3 access
Define tool Build-vs-Buy ADR plan without selecting a universal framework
Validate the existing Research Validation Specialist authority boundary
Define ex-ante regime and universe selection methodology
Reconcile AR-0 state across GitHub and Linear
out_of_scope: Implementing the AR-1 reproducible research harness
Selecting a production or universal research/backtest framework
Profitability claims, BUY/SELL, risk approval or execution
dependencies: Alpha Research Fast Track addendum canonical
tests: Task Contract validates against the canonical task schema
All AR-0 JSON artifacts parse and required governance fields are present
AR-FT evidence envelope schema contains the governed decision vocabulary and audit fields
Confirmatory Hypothesis Contract schema requires freeze-before-access fields
Point-in-time safety contract requires availability/vintage/decision-clock semantics and fail-closed uncertainty
Confirmatory dataset access requires a frozen hypothesis/config contract
Contaminated confirmatory partitions are retired and versioned
Unsupported numeric thresholds are not frozen and remain TO_BE_CALIBRATED
Research Validation Specialist remains parented under A4 and cannot pass canonical gates
AR-0 deterministic governance evidence is byte-identical across two runs
security_tests: No BUY/SELL, profitability, risk approval or execution authority is introduced
No secrets or credentials are required
Research data access remains task-authorized and partition-scoped
evidence: Alpha Research Fast Track canonical addendum
rollback: Revert only AR-0 governance package, CI wiring and shared-state reconciliation. The canonical Alpha Research Fast Track addendum remains intact; AR-0 returns to READY_NOT_STARTED and AR-1+ remain blocked.
definition_of_ready: No conflicting open PR or shared-writer lock
definition_of_done: AR-0 required outputs are versioned and machine-readable where applicable
Evidence and confirmatory hypothesis schemas are present and validated
Research Validation Specialist authority is validated
Post-merge Governance and Branch Hygiene pass
